helpScreen.title: Help & support
helpScreen.faq1Question: What happens if I miss a contribution?
helpScreen.faq1Answer: A late penalty defined by your group applies after the grace period. Other members are informed to preserve transparency.
helpScreen.faq2Question: How are my Mobile Money payments secured?
helpScreen.faq2Answer: Your payments go through your Mobile Money operator: Cercle never stores your secret code or credentials. Every transaction is confirmed by the operator and traced in the group's ledger.
helpScreen.faq3Question: Can I leave a group mid-cycle?
helpScreen.faq3Answer: Yes. If your turn hasn't come yet, your contributions are refunded after the admin's validation. If you already received it, a balance is due before the effective exit.
helpScreen.faq4Question: How does the reliability score work?
helpScreen.faq4Answer: It's computed from your on-time contributions, delays, and loan repayments. It's visible to your groups' members.
